config.name: Overland Track
config.region: Cradle Mountain–Lake St Clair National Park (TAS)
config.description: Tasmania's alpine walk from Ronny Creek in Cradle Valley to Narcissus Hut at the head of Lake St Clair, past Barn Bluff, Mount Ossa and the Du Cane Range. From Narcissus most walkers take the ferry to Cynthia Bay; the lakeside track there is carried as an alternative finish. Side trips to Cradle Mountain, Barn Bluff, Lake Will, Mount Pelion East, Mount Ossa, Pine Valley, and Hartnett and Fergusson Falls are included. Between 1 October and 31 May the track is booked, and walked north to south.
